Hi Marta — Ben from Redwood here (looping in since this looks like an organizer/ICS quirk). Apologies for the hiccup.

We tracked down the issue: when the invite was generated via our scheduling tool it created an organizer alias that Google is stripping the event-level join metadata from for some domains — which results in the "blank join" behavior you saw. Two steps we’ll take now:

1) I’m re-issuing a new calendar invite with the Zoom join URL explicitly pasted into the event description (so clients that strip metadata still see a clickable link). I’m also attaching a standalone .ics that contains the full join URL as a fallback.
2) I’ll add your domain (novisys.co) to our event-override allowlist for this event so users behind SSO can follow the link without being blocked by the organizer alias. If for any reason your admin still sees SSO enforcement, we’ll provide an alternate Meet link and a dial-in number.

Next actions: I will send the updated invite now (subject unchanged). Please accept the new invite — the old one will auto-cancel. If Aleks still sees issues, reply to this thread and I’ll generate a one-click Zoom passkey for your engineer.

Thanks for the patience — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
